name: Zhainan de Renjian Maoxian: Shijie Zhishi Yizhi Zai Xuanzhuan
original_name: 宅男的人间冒险：世界只是一直在旋转
source:
Will the Earth be destroyed soon?
Will you choose only one between the Earth and Waifu?
In this story, the player will travel through time and space via a time machine, meet all kinds of different people, find clues and growth, and find ways to save both Waifu and the Earth.

Sequel to Waifu's route of the original.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610220]Steam[/url]]
